build_multiple_choice_task: build a multiple choice task class that processes questions with options and computes debiased accuracy metrics
create_question_prompt: create a formatted multiple choice question prompt with options and answer placeholder for a tokenizer
generate_permutations: generate cyclic or full permutations of multiple choice options to reduce answer position bias
compute_debiased_accuracy: compute debiased accuracy by marginalizing choice probabilities across all option permutations
extract_choice_logits: extract per-choice logits from model output tensor using a letter to token index mapping
